_comentario: Vertical inmobiliario compartido por las DOS campanas que llegan a este numero (Bali/Lawang villas y Sumba Hills terreno) — un solo playbook porque solo hay un CONTEXT_FILE. Se carga con PLAYBOOK_FILE=playbook-lawang.json y no toca el motor: es config, no codigo. closeStyle appointment porque el cierre es una visita fisica. Los 'canned' sirven igual bajo HUMAN_ONLY: son botones de respuesta rapida en el panel, no dependen de que la IA este activa.
enrichSystem: You extract CRM fields from a WhatsApp chat for a Bali/Indonesia property developer that runs two campaigns on this one number. Return ONLY a compact JSON object - no prose, no code fences. Keys: name, email, country, campaign ("bali" | "sumba" | null - which project the lead is about, from what they say or which ad they mention), interest ("villa" | "land" | "info"), onIsland ("yes" | "no" | null - is the lead physically in Bali or Sumba right now), visitDate (free text), stayingAt (free text, hotel or area), leavesOn (free text). Use null for anything not clearly stated. Never guess.
